I Thought It Was Clothing, But It’s Clay! The Knitted Mug That Fools 99%

Hello, this is King Process.
In this video, we filmed the construction process of 63 Sky Picnic, a newly created observation deck located 250 meters above Seoul at the top of the 63 Building.
Reopening after 16 years, this observation deck features an LED display covering the entire floor and flexible mirrors installed across the ceiling, creating an immersive space where the visuals appear to continue endlessly above and below.
The project was carried out by XORBIS, a digital content company specializing in immersive media art using virtual reality and AI technology.
The video shows the assembly of the pedestals and lower support frames used to level the LED floor, the laser alignment process accurate to within 1 millimeter, and the installation of approximately 330 large LED screens.
